about.paragraph1: I'm Anissah, a wellness massage practitioner certified by Magic Hands School. Sakina Massage 974 invites you into a space dedicated to deep relaxation and letting go. We believe that taking care of yourself isn't a luxury — it's a necessity.
about.paragraph2: Discover our wellness massages and Head Spa treatments, designed to relieve everyday stress, relax your muscles and revive your energy in a peaceful setting in Saint-Paul.

headSpaZoneCiblee.desc: Precise work on cranial tension, circulation and the nervous system, completed by a targeted-area massage.

footSpaMassageJambes.desc: Relaxing foot bath, exfoliation, foot and leg massage for light, soothed legs.

massageAbhyanga.desc: Ayurvedic ritual with warm oils that rebalances body and mind, soothes the mind and provides a sense of wellbeing.

packBienEtre.desc: Cranial relaxation, relaxing body massage and leg, foot & hand massage for overall wellbeing.

video.title: Your moment of absolute wellness
video.text: Escape the everyday. Take a moment to breathe, relax and recharge in the expert hands of our practitioner.

review1.text: A moment of pure relaxation. Anissah has magic hands, I always leave feeling calm and light. The Head Spa is simply incredible.
review1.author: Nadia R.

review2.text: The draining massage was excellent, I really felt the difference from the first session. The welcome is warm and the setting very soothing.
review2.author: Karine L.

review3.text: The duo massage with my sister was a wonderful experience to share. We loved it, we'll definitely be back!
review3.author: Sophie M.

review4.text: Clean space, calm atmosphere, and above all real expertise. The deep tissue massage relieved my back tension.
review4.author: Thomas D.

review5.text: Sakina Massage 974 has become my monthly wellness appointment. Professionalism and kindness every visit.
review5.author: Fatima B.

review6.text: The foot spa was exactly what I needed after a long week. Thank you Anissah for this gentle moment.
review6.author: Julien P.

services.pageSubtitle: Discover the full range of our wellness treatments, designed and performed by Anissah for your deep relaxation.
services.personnelNote: Staff rate reserved for public and private sector employees.

headSpaZoneCiblee.intro: Our Head Spa is different… because it doesn't just relax: it's precise work on cranial tension, circulation, the nervous system, completed by a targeted-area massage.
details: A Japanese ritual for a lighter mind: scalp care, relaxing cranial massage, facial massage and deep relaxation, achieved solely through the expertise of touch.
headSpaZoneCiblee.note: Staff rate reserved for public and private sector employees.

footSpaMassageJambes.intro: Give your feet and legs a true moment of escape.
details: Light feet for a more serene body: exfoliation, buffing and smoothing, relaxing foot and leg massage, and semi-permanent polish application.
footSpaMassageJambes.note: Staff rate reserved for public and private sector employees.

massageAbhyanga.intro: A traditional Indian massage with warm oils that rebalances body and mind, soothes the mind and provides a deep sense of wellbeing.
details: A journey to the heart of India, performed with natural Ayurvedic oils in a personalized and caring approach.
benefits: Provides a feeling of overall wellbeing
massageAbhyanga.note: Staff rate reserved for public and private sector employees.

packBienEtre.intro: A moment just for you: taking care of yourself every day with a complete treatment for body and mind.
details: Cranial relaxation, neck release & back massage, relaxing body massage, then leg, foot & hand massage.
packBienEtre.note: Staff rate reserved for public and private sector employees.

bonCadeau.intro: A wellness moment just for you: massages, Head Spa, Foot Spa and wellness treatments. Because taking care of yourself is essential.
details: Give more than a treatment, give a moment of happiness. The Gift Voucher lets you choose from any of our services for a custom-tailored moment of relaxation.
